description: A same-family teacher->student distillation run: dataset manifest, training config, evaluation result, signed run record and model card.
authority: The Master owns the run record and signs it through the isolated signer after operator approval. The trainer holds no signer.

config.family: string; teacher and student must match unless an explicit cross-family experiment is recorded

dataset.selection: family + consent + window; opted-out users excluded
dataset.redaction: keys, secrets and excluded personal paths removed; dedupe by prompt hash

evaluation.reject_if: any configured threshold is missed; the run is recorded as rejected and no model card is published

model_card.publication: optional, through the signed 4221 file share after operator approval; a peer deploys it only as a distinct model, never by overwriting its base

limits.raw_kv: raw KV tensors are archived/research data; cross-size distillation trains on traces/logits unless an architecture-compatible experiment is explicitly recorded
limits.hardware: make distill-doctor must pass before a run; a failed check refuses the run
limits.no_auto_training: a run is operator-triggered; data volume alone never starts one
